scope: Prepared owned snapshot and atomic store API; all native callers remain unchanged
checks: use pinned native cache entry and link_list.h implementations
allocate replacement before taking cache lock; allocation failure preserves old entry
lookup, unlink, append and count update under one cache lock
replace existing key at capacity; refuse new key at capacity
retire replaced entry after unlock; balance allocation/free
snapshot remains owned after immediate matched-node retirement
preconditions: caller supplies owned input values and separately validates request identity
all cache readers must use owned values before this store API is installed
remaining: IAPP token/completion integration and paired target checks
